1.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Wind<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
1.description: Typhon's signature technique produces gale-force winds by propelling concentrated air through the nostrils─though mages recreate the gust externally, for the sake of nasal integrity. In addition to buffeting foes backward, it appears to have a detrimental effect on its target's mental state.
1.translation_description: La tecnica caratteristica di Tifone scatena venti di burrasca spingendo aria concentrata attraverso le narici; i maghi, per salvaguardarle, ricreano la corrente dall’esterno. Oltre a sbalzare indietro i nemici, sembra compromettere la lucidità del bersaglio.

2.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Blunt<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
2.description: Employed to great effect by Ultros, this technique crushes adversaries beneath a phantom weight. Due to reticence in the scholastic community regarding certain forms of testing, whether the weight applied feels like that of four full tonzes is a question that remains unanswered.
2.translation_description: Ultros usa questa tecnica con grande efficacia, schiacciando gli avversari sotto un peso illusorio. Poiché gli studiosi esitano a condurre certi esperimenti, resta senza risposta la domanda se il peso percepito equivalga davvero a quattro tonze.

3.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Water<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
3.description: This spell, easily mastered via defeat of a kraken, fires a concentrated burst of water at one's opponent. As the liquid itself is conjured by manipulating aether to condense moisture in the air, the technique remains effective regardless of whether or not its caster has access to a body of water.
3.translation_description: Questa magia, che si apprende facilmente sconfiggendo un kraken, scaglia contro l’avversario un getto d’acqua concentrato. Poiché il liquido si crea condensando l’umidità dell’aria con l’etere, la tecnica funziona anche senza una fonte d’acqua.

4.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
4.description: Favored by sirens, the Song of Torment carries in its melody a malicious enchantment. It ensnares the listener's spirit, inducing phantom pain that soon becomes physical as the body struggles to process the mind's trauma.
4.translation_description: Prediletto dalle sirene, il Canto del Tormento nasconde nella melodia un incanto maligno. Intrappola lo spirito di chi ascolta, infliggendo un dolore fantasma che diventa presto fisico, mentre il corpo fatica a elaborare il trauma della mente.

5.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Lightning<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
5.description: An industrial form of machina-based aetherial manipulation developed and adapted by the Allagan Empire. Through the compression of ambient lightning-aspected aether, the caster (or casting machina) floods the vicinity with highly charged arcs of electricity.
5.translation_description: Tecnica industriale di manipolazione eterea basata sulle machina, sviluppata e perfezionata dall’Impero Allagano. Comprimendo l’etere circostante di elemento fulmine, chi la lancia (o la machina stessa) riempie l’area di scariche elettriche ad alto voltaggio.

6.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
6.description: This spell manipulates wind- and earth-aspected aether to call forth the umbral, imbuing exhaled air with miasma. Attempts to replicate the morbol's Bad Breath sans its inherent horrific stench have been unsuccessful, thus it retains its title as the <hex:021A020203>foulest<hex:021A020103> of blue magicks.
6.translation_description: La magia sfrutta l’etere di affinità Aero e Pietra per richiamare l’ombra, infondendo miasma nell’aria espirata. I tentativi di riprodurre il Cattivo Alito dei morbol senza il suo fetore insopportabile sono falliti: resta così la <hex:021A020203>più immonda<hex:021A020103> delle magie blu.

7.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Blunt<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
7.description: Replicating this technique requires magically altering one's own state of mind to mimic that of a zu. The flying strike that results surpasses normal physical limitations, but requires dispensing with caution in favor of an all-consuming rage─the sensible mage will shield herself with aether first.
7.translation_description: Per replicare questa tecnica bisogna alterare magicamente il proprio stato mentale e assumere quello di uno zu. Il colpo volante che ne deriva supera i normali limiti fisici, ma richiede di abbandonare ogni cautela in preda a una furia incontenibile; un mago assennato si protegge prima con l’etere.

8.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Water<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
8.description: The most quintessential of water-aspected blue magicks. A competent mage will not only use its bubbles to smother nearby enemies, but also incorporate poisons, sealing the fates of any survivors.
8.translation_description: La più classica delle magie blu di affinità Idro. Un mago esperto può usare le bolle non solo per soffocare i nemici vicini, ma anche per avvelenarli, condannando i sopravvissuti.

9.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Earth<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
9.description: Just like that all-too-well-known fixture in the arsenals of many earthy soulkin, this technique creates a localized quake around the caster. According to legend, the earth itself will appear to shatter under a true master of the spell.
9.translation_description: Come la celebre magia usata da tante stirpi legate alla terra, questa tecnica provoca un sisma localizzato attorno a chi la lancia. Secondo la leggenda, sotto un vero maestro l’intera terra sembra spaccarsi.

10.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
10.description: This technique pelts foes with seedlike aetherial orbs, which then explode to release the soporific within. Scholars believe that similar defense mechanisms were originally developed by treants and other species vulnerable to vilekin in order to prevent their boring of holes and leeching of sap.
10.translation_description: La tecnica bersaglia i nemici con sfere eteree simili a semi, che esplodono liberando una sostanza soporifera. Gli studiosi ritengono che meccanismi di difesa simili siano stati sviluppati da treant e altre specie vulnerabili ai parassiti per impedire loro di scavare gallerie e succhiare la linfa.

11.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
11.description: Instinctive to beastkin, Bristle channels sheer animalistic rage into heightened spiritual and physical power. The blue mage will find that she can adapt this technique to increase her spells' potency.
11.translation_description: L’Ispidezza convoglia la pura ferocia animale in una maggiore potenza spirituale e fisica. Un mago blu può adattare questa tecnica per aumentare la potenza dei propri incantesimi.

12.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
12.description: Primarily used by soulflayers, though reportedly also found in Blaster's arsenal, Mind Blast assaults nearby foes' perceptions, tormenting them with the sensation of manifold cuts. Senses overwhelmed, victims' bodies react as if perception were reality, leaving them wounded and paralyzed.
12.translation_description: Usata soprattutto dagli squartaspiriti, ma a quanto pare presente anche nell’arsenale di Blaster, Esplosione Mentale assale la percezione dei nemici vicini e li tormenta con la sensazione di subire innumerevoli tagli. Sopraffatti dai sensi, i corpi delle vittime reagiscono come se la percezione fosse reale, lasciandole ferite e paralizzate.

13.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
13.description: Through the draining of blood, this spell saps a foe's aether, a portion of which is then absorbed by the caster. In nature, such habits first appeared in creatures such as bats and chigoes, who naturalists theorize developed the ability to absorb nutrients via blood over the course of centuries.
13.translation_description: Questa magia prosciuga l’etere del nemico drenandone il sangue, di cui il lanciatore assorbe una parte. In natura, questa strategia comparve dapprima in creature come pipistrelli e chigoe. Secondo i naturalisti, nel corso dei secoli hanno sviluppato la capacità di assorbire nutrienti dal sangue.

14.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Fire<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
14.description: This spell creates an aetherial replica of the sort of bomb preferred by goblins. Of course, goblin bombs acquire their combustive force through the use of magically enhanced gunpowder, so mimicking this effect with aether alone requires no small amount of effort, but the results are...explosive.
14.translation_description: Questa magia crea una replica eterea della bomba preferita dai goblin. Le bombe goblin esplodono grazie alla polvere da sparo potenziata magicamente: ottenere lo stesso effetto con il solo etere richiede un notevole sforzo, ma il risultato è... esplosivo.

15.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Piercing<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
15.description: Highly famed─and feared─due to its frequent use by cactuars, 1000 Needles showers one's surroundings with a hail of slim projectiles. Despite their magical nature, the velocity at which the blue mage's pseudo-spines are propelled ensures that they are quite as painful as the real thing.
15.translation_description: Famosa e temuta per il frequente uso da parte dei cactuar, Mille Aghi bersaglia i dintorni con una pioggia di sottili proiettili. Sebbene siano magiche, le spine simulate del mago blu vengono scagliate a una velocità tale da fare male quanto quelle vere.

16.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Piercing<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
16.description: This technique mimics the Drill Cannons of machina by winding aetherial currents until they resemble rapidly spinning projectiles. Like the physical drills upon which they are patterned, these projectiles excel at penetrating stone.
16.translation_description: Questa tecnica imita i cannoni perforanti delle machina, caricando correnti eteree fino a farle ruotare come proiettili. Come le trivelle a cui si ispira, i proiettili perforano la pietra con grande efficacia.

17.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
17.description: Common amongst dahaks, this technique requires using the position of one's own eyes to anchor arcane geometries in which to concentrate aether. The user then expels the aether, propelled by ill will, in the direction of his gaze─though this tends to earn him a fair bit of ire in return.
17.translation_description: Comune tra i dahak, questa tecnica usa la posizione degli occhi come punto d’ancoraggio per geometrie arcane che concentrano l’etere. Il lanciatore lo scaglia quindi con lo sguardo, carico di malanimo; di solito, però, si attira parecchia ostilità.

18.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Slashing<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
18.description: At this point, tonberries' predilection for sharpened knives is well known. By manipulating aether to harness feelings of resentment, one hones a keener blade for driving into the heart of the enemy. Naturally, being beset by this attack while unable to move is a uniquely harrowing experience.
18.translation_description: Ormai è nota la passione dei tonberry per i coltelli affilati. Manipolando l’etere e attingendo al risentimento, il lanciatore affila una lama da conficcare nel cuore del nemico. Subire questo attacco senza potersi muovere è un’esperienza particolarmente straziante.

19.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
19.description: To utilize this simple teleportation spell, casters must create an aetherial current upon which to travel between their location and the desired position. Though this is only effective over short distances, it is nevertheless an invaluable tool in the event that one needs to beat a hasty retreat.
19.translation_description: Per usare questo semplice incantesimo di teletrasporto, il lanciatore crea una corrente eterea che lo trasporta dalla posizione attuale a quella desiderata. Funziona solo a breve distanza, ma è prezioso per una rapida ritirata.

20.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Fire<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
20.description: As with thaumaturgical fire spells, the jet of flame produced by this technique manifests from a burst of fire-aspected aether. Certain weapons produce similar effects; however, this is not through aetherial manipulation, but rather the copious use of highly flammable liquid.
20.translation_description: Come le magie di fuoco del taumaturgo, la fiammata di questa tecnica nasce da un’esplosione di etere di elemento Fuoco. Alcune armi producono effetti simili, ma senza manipolare l’etere: sfruttano invece grandi quantità di liquidi altamente infiammabili.

21.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
21.description: Originally developed as a means of defense from flesh-eating beasts, this favorite of the Qiqirn tribes produces a shockwave as its user strikes together palms filled with concentrated aether, leaving foes witless.
21.translation_description: Ideata per difendersi dalle bestie carnivore, questa tecnica prediletta dalle tribù qiqirn genera un’onda d’urto quando il lanciatore batte i palmi colmi di etere concentrato, lasciando i nemici storditi.

22.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Lightning<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
22.description: Perhaps best known as the unsettling hallmark of the cyclops, Glower involves funneling aether through the eyes as if they were arcane circles─much like its sister spell, The Look. Its highly concentrated aether strikes foes like a levinbolt, leaving their skin singed and muscles seizing.
22.translation_description: Forse noto soprattutto come tratto inquietante dei ciclopi, Sguardo Torvo convoglia l’etere dagli occhi come fossero cerchi arcani, proprio come la magia sorella Lo Sguardo. L’etere, estremamente concentrato, colpisce i nemici come un fulmine, bruciandone la pelle e paralizzandone i muscoli.

23.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
23.description: A magical imitation of warmachina technology, this technique allows the user to fire a barrage of aetherial missiles. When efficacious─which, bear in mind, is not guaranteed─it sends a shock through the foe that appears to resonate more the greater their vitality.
23.translation_description: Imitazione magica della tecnologia delle machina da guerra, questa tecnica consente di lanciare una raffica di missili eterei. Se va a segno (e non è garantito), provoca nel nemico una scarica che sembra crescere con la sua vitalità.

24.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
24.description: White Wind imbues a localized current of air with purified aether, distributing its curative effects throughout the vicinity. Though powerful for such a simple spell, the purification of sufficient aether requires significant magical exertion on the part of the caster, and thus should be used sparingly.
24.translation_description: Vento Bianco infonde etere purificato in una corrente d’aria locale, diffondendone gli effetti curativi nei dintorni. Nonostante la potenza, purificare abbastanza etere richiede un grande sforzo magico: va quindi usato con parsimonia.

25.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Piercing<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
25.description: A desperate mage's last resort, this technique converts all of the user's life force to an aetherial poison that is then injected into a single adversary. Suffice it to say that, as with the physical sting of the wespe, it should not be relied upon in but the most dire of circumstances.
25.translation_description: Ultima risorsa di un mago disperato: questa tecnica converte tutta la forza vitale in un veleno etereo da iniettare in un singolo avversario. Come la puntura di una vespa, va usata solo nelle situazioni più disperate.

26.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Fire<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
26.description: Credited as the source of the “bomb” voidsent family's name, Self-destruct, when used by blue mages, converts the entirety of its caster's energy into fire-aspected aether to cause an explosion. The application of oil has been observed to make it more effective─though likely also more painful.
26.translation_description: Autodistruzione, da cui prende il nome la famiglia di creature del Vuoto chiamate “bombe”, converte tutta l’energia del lanciatore in etere di elemento fuoco e provoca un’esplosione. L’olio sembra potenziarne l’effetto, ma probabilmente rende anche l’esplosione più dolorosa.

27.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
27.description: At times used by self-sacrificing spirits of the dead roaming the New World, this technique consumes the entirety of one's being to fully restore both the body and mind of another. Though the sacrifice required is great, the use of this spell is a deed not soon forgotten.
27.translation_description: Talvolta usata dagli spiriti altruisti dei defunti che vagano per il Nuovo Mondo, questa tecnica sacrifica l’intera essenza del lanciatore per ristabilire completamente il corpo e la mente di un’altra persona. È un sacrificio grande, ma chi riceve questo dono non lo dimentica facilmente.

28.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
28.description: This technique covers the blue mage's body in oil, much like a gigantoad's slime would its own, allowing the caster to slip and slide away from foes' attacks. Though most consider it uncouth at best, make no mistake─its devotees are few, but ardent.
28.translation_description: Questa tecnica ricopre il corpo del mago blu d’olio, come il muco di un rospo gigante, permettendogli di scivolare via dagli attacchi nemici. Molti la considerano quantomeno indecorosa, ma i suoi pochi adepti sono davvero appassionati.

29.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
29.description: A primitive type of curse cast by giants in the New World, this spell sunders opponents' defenses by breaking their spirits. Pairing it with strong offensive magic allows the blue mage to weaken and strike down foe after foe without cease.
29.translation_description: Maledizione primitiva lanciata dai giganti del Nuovo Mondo, spezza lo spirito degli avversari e ne infrange le difese. Abbinata a potenti magie offensive, permette al mago blu di indebolire e abbattere nemici senza sosta.

30.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Blunt<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
30.description: In nature, Sticky Tongue is employed by gigantoads, who extend said lengthy and unusually adhesive appendages to capture distant prey. The blue magic rendition utilizes a far more sanitary aetherial “tongue,” but the principle is the same.
30.translation_description: In natura, i rospi giganti usano la Lingua Appiccicosa allungando le loro lingue lunghe e insolitamente adesive per catturare prede lontane. La versione di magia blu usa una “lingua” eterea molto più igienica, ma il principio è lo stesso.

31.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
31.description: Karlabos performs Tail Screw by collecting turbulent aether in the tip of its tail, then unleashing it at once as a violent whorl that rips foes' lives from their bodies. This is notoriously difficult to imitate, due to the challenges inherent in attempting to control such a volatile aetherial vortex.
31.translation_description: Karlabos esegue la Coda a Vite raccogliendo etere turbolento sulla punta della coda e sprigionandolo in un vortice violento che strappa la vita ai nemici. È notoriamente difficile da imitare, poiché controllare un vortice etereo tanto instabile è un’impresa ardua.

32.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
32.description: This curse, commonly used by ahrimans and similar voidsent, takes advantage of the hubris that living creatures tend to fall prey to upon reaching certain malmstones in development, targeting mental weaknesses to give foes a paralyzing reminder of their own fallibility.
32.translation_description: Maledizione comune tra gli ahriman e creature del Vuoto simili, sfrutta la presunzione che coglie gli esseri viventi al raggiungimento di certe pietremiliari della crescita. Colpisce le loro debolezze mentali e ricorda ai nemici, paralizzandoli, quanto siano vulnerabili.

33.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
33.description: This technique imitates a peculiar flute wrested from the grasp of a vanquished voidsent. Said creature was initially welcomed as a god by those New World peoples who worship the moon, but it soon became clear to them that the flute was the true source of its power and cruel authority.
33.translation_description: Questa tecnica imita uno strano flauto sottratto a una creatura del Vuoto sconfitta. I popoli del Nuovo Mondo che venerano la luna accolsero inizialmente la creatura come una divinità, ma capirono presto che la vera fonte del suo potere e della sua crudele autorità era il flauto.

34.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
34.description: Oft cast by voidsent in the New World, this mortal curse merely hints that one's time may be nigh. For particularly suggestible opponents, however, this is enough─the looming specter of death will send them leaping to their graves.
34.translation_description: Spesso lanciata dalle creature del Vuoto nel Nuovo Mondo, questa maledizione mortale si limita a suggerire che la fine sia vicina. Contro gli avversari più suggestionabili basta questo: lo spettro della morte incombe e li spinge a correre verso la tomba.

35.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
35.description: Protected by only a dainty layer of scales, some Indigo Deep-dwellers' survival has come to depend on aetherial manipulation─this technique included. By reducing the amount of aether used for offense, more becomes available for the creation of a strong─if flashy─barrier.
35.translation_description: Protette solo da un sottile strato di scaglie, alcune creature degli Abissi Indaco sono sopravvissute grazie alla manipolazione eterea, e questa tecnica ne è un esempio. Riducendo l’etere usato per attaccare, se ne può concentrare di più in una barriera robusta, per quanto vistosa.

36.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Ice<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
36.description: Favored by certain types of voidsent, this spell─technically a curse, cast upon oneself─converts the malice of attackers into aetherial spikes of ice, impaling them each time they strike. The more furious their flurries, the more pain they cause themselves─poetic justice, one might say.
36.translation_description: Prediletta da alcune creature del Vuoto, questa magia è tecnicamente una maledizione rivolta a chi la lancia: converte la malizia degli aggressori in spine di ghiaccio eteree che li trafiggono a ogni colpo. Più furiosi sono i loro attacchi, più dolore si infliggono: una giustizia poetica.

37.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Ice<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
37.description: Scholars theorize that this particular spell was born of the variety of aetherial manipulation often performed by northern rams to survive the harsh climes of high elevations─but when ram became chimerical head, it began to favor offense over defense.
37.translation_description: Gli studiosi ipotizzano che questa magia nasca da una forma di manipolazione eterea usata spesso dagli arieti del nord per sopravvivere al clima rigido delle alte quote. Quando però l’ariete divenne la testa di una chimera, la tecnica passò all’attacco.

38.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Lightning<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
38.description: The blue mage's ability to precisely direct volatile levin to form the smooth ring produced by this spell is owed to the chimera from which the technique was learned─and whose control of lightning aether was, in turn, owed to its draconic head.
38.translation_description: La capacità del mago blu di guidare con precisione il fulmine instabile e creare il cerchio perfetto di questa magia viene dalla chimera da cui l’ha appresa, che controllava l’etere di elemento Tuono grazie alla testa draconica.

39.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
39.description: A variant on a salamander specialty, Peculiar Light disperses radiance naturally emitted during spellcasting into a half-globe, clouding victims' vision. Thus unbeknownst to them, malignant aether lurking within the rapidly reflecting beams renders them more susceptible to further aetherial assaults.
39.translation_description: Variante di una specialità della salamandra, Luce Bizzarra disperde in una semisfera la luce emessa durante il lancio degli incantesimi, offuscando la vista delle vittime. A loro insaputa, l’etere maligno nei raggi che si riflettono rapidamente le rende più vulnerabili a ulteriori attacchi eterei.

40.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
40.description: Ink Jet can be considered a more advanced form of Water Cannon─fitting, as both come courtesy of the kraken. The spell infuses aetherially concentrated water with whatever impure substances are most readily available to create and expel a synthetic “ink,” blinding opponents.
40.translation_description: Getto d’Inchiostro è una versione più avanzata del Cannone d’Acqua, coerentemente: entrambe le magie provengono dal kraken. Infondendo etere nell’acqua concentrata e aggiungendo le impurità più facilmente reperibili, il mago crea un “inchiostro” artificiale che acceca gli avversari.

41.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Piercing<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
41.description: The apkallu, in the wild, violently regurgitates its latest pescatarian meal at predators as a defense mechanism. In blue magic trials, Flying Sardine has proven to be an equally effective deterrent even when the sardine in question is not entirely physical, reliably shocking adversaries into silence.
41.translation_description: In natura, l’apkallu rigurgita violentemente il suo ultimo pasto di pesce contro i predatori per difendersi. Nelle prove di magia blu, Sardina Volante si è dimostrata altrettanto efficace, pur non essendo una sardina del tutto materiale: stordisce puntualmente gli avversari e li riduce al silenzio.

42.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
42.description: Diamondback weaves earth-aspected aether into a hard mineral shield, mimicking what many describe as the “maddening” effect of shelled dragons' carapaces. Alas, though its defensive properties are superlative, its weight makes it impossible for the caster to move while under its aegis.
42.translation_description: Dorso di Diamante intreccia etere di elemento Pietra in uno scudo minerale rigido, imitando l’effetto “snervante” del carapace dei draghi corazzati. La difesa è eccezionale, ma il peso impedisce al lanciatore di muoversi mentre è protetto.

43.description: In imitation of a martial technique passed down for generations by Mamool Ja tribes in the New World, this spell imbues a long-headed spear called an “angon”─or rather, an aetherial replica of the same─with fire-aspected aether and propels it across the field at enemy combatants.
43.translation_description: A imitazione di una tecnica marziale tramandata per generazioni dalle tribù Mamool Ja del Nuovo Mondo, questa magia infonde etere di elemento Fuoco in una lunga lancia appuntita chiamata angone, o meglio in una sua replica eterea, e la scaglia contro i nemici.

44.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Wind<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★★<hex:02100103>
44.description: Feather Rain, as swift and brutal as most of Garuda's skills, puts the force of a gale behind a storm of sharp plumes, afflicting foes with innumerable cuts and lashes that cause lingering agony.
44.translation_description: Pioggia di Piume, rapida e brutale come molte tecniche di Garuda, scatena una tempesta di piume affilate che infligge ai nemici innumerevoli tagli e frustate, lasciando un dolore persistente.

45.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Fire<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★★<hex:02100103>
45.description: Necessitating the skill to manipulate currents beneath the earth as Ifrit does, Eruption drives the fire within the land above ground in a burst of explosive flame, creating an effect similar to that of a volcano.
45.translation_description: Per replicare Eruzione bisogna saper manipolare le correnti sotterranee, come Ifrit. La tecnica spinge in superficie il fuoco custodito nelle profondità in un’esplosione di fiamme, creando un effetto simile a quello di un vulcano.

46.description: In a devastating recreation of one of Titan's most fearsome techniques, Mountain Buster strikes opponents with an upheaval of earth-aspected aether, as if the land itself were ripping free of its confines to pulverize its defilers─or any unfortunate bystanders, as it were.
46.translation_description: Spaccamonti, riproduzione devastante di una delle tecniche più temibili di Titano, colpisce gli avversari con un’ondata di etere di elemento Pietra, come se la terra stessa si liberasse dai vincoli per schiacciare chi l’ha profanata e chiunque abbia la sfortuna di trovarsi vicino.

47.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Lightning<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★★<hex:02100103>
47.description: Shock Strike, never so imposing as when cast by Ramuh, calls down a bolt from the heavens. Though measurements are difficult to come by, its power is thought to far exceed that of levinbolts found in nature─indeed, it more closely resembles a warhammer crashing to the earth.
47.translation_description: Colpo Folgorante, nella sua forma più imponente quando lo lancia Ramuh, richiama un fulmine dal cielo. È difficile misurarne la potenza, ma si ritiene che superi di molto quella dei fulmini naturali; somiglia piuttosto a un martello da guerra che si abbatte al suolo.

48.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Ice<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★★<hex:02100103>
48.description: To fully replicate this technique, beloved of Shiva, the blue mage calls forth a bow of aether from which she fires a hail of razor-sharp icicles. Those who knew the lady Ysayle believe that Glass Dance may have taken form from her memories of observing hunters in Tailfeather.
48.translation_description: Per replicare pienamente questa tecnica, prediletta da Shiva, il mago blu crea un arco d’etere e scaglia una raffica di stalattiti affilate. Chi conosceva la dama Ysayle ritiene che Danza di Vetro sia nata dai suoi ricordi dei cacciatori di Codapiuma.

49.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Water<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★★<hex:02100103>
49.description: This fearsome magic, inspired by Leviathan, creates an aqueous film of water collected from the atmosphere. Though a veil in the sense of offering protection from outside forces, it also functions as a mirror, reflecting foes' aether back upon them.
49.translation_description: Questa terribile magia, ispirata a Leviatano, crea un velo d’acqua raccolta dall’atmosfera. Protegge dalle forze esterne, ma funge anche da specchio che riflette contro i nemici il loro stesso etere.

50.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Wind<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
50.description: So fierce as to match the gales that pierce Abalathia's Spine, the gusting wind produced by this spell is commonly put to use by wild griffins in driving trespassers from their jealously guarded territory.
50.translation_description: La raffica prodotta da questa magia è tanto violenta da rivaleggiare con i venti che sferzano la Spina di Abalathia. I grifoni selvatici la usano spesso per scacciare gli intrusi dal territorio che difendono gelosamente.

51.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Water<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
51.description: This technique originates with the living liquid, which coalesces about a hydrate core that allows it to dispense its own fluid in a violent flood. The magically reproduced version, correctly applied, is equally effective in sweeping away even the bulkiest of foes.
51.translation_description: Questa tecnica nasce dal Fluido Vivente, che si raccoglie attorno a un nucleo idrato e può scagliare il proprio liquido in un’inondazione violenta. Riprodotta con la magia e usata correttamente, spazza via anche i nemici più massicci.

52.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Ice<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
52.description: Owing to the unique refrigerant in its saliva, the yeti is able to chill its own breath to such great extent that said gust of air rapidly freezes ambient water-aspected aether. By magically generating a similar blizzard, the mage becomes particularly effective against foes afflicted with dropsy.
52.translation_description: Grazie a un refrigerante unico nella saliva, lo yeti può raffreddare il proprio respiro tanto da congelare all’istante l’etere di affinità Idro circostante. Ricreando magicamente una tormenta simile, il mago è particolarmente efficace contro i nemici colpiti da Idropisia.

53.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Lightning<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
53.description: This efficacious technique is, in nature, employed by the voracious sea serpent, which will spit a bubble of water that takes on the electric charge of the serpent's own scales─giving the creature's prey a rather nasty shock upon impact.
53.translation_description: Questa tecnica, usata in natura dal vorace serpente marino, sputa una bolla d’acqua che si carica con l’elettricità delle sue scaglie. All’impatto, la preda riceve una brutta scossa.

54.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Slashing<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
54.description: To employ this technique, it is first necessary to replicate the panzer doll's fearsome spear, which is then swung in an arc to cut foes down quicker than they can blink.
54.translation_description: Per usare questa tecnica bisogna prima ricreare la temibile lancia della bambola panzer, poi brandirla in un arco che abbatte i nemici prima che possano battere ciglio.

55.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Piercing<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
55.description: An arch demon specialty, Abyssal Transfixion weaves aether into a globe of blades that are then plunged inward to pierce a target in unison. This harrowing experience generally has the effect of paralyzing said target with a visceral terror, making it an invaluable addition to one's arsenal.
55.translation_description: Specialità di un arcidemone, Trafiggimento Abissale intesse l’etere in una sfera di lame che si richiudono tutte insieme su un bersaglio. L’esperienza è così terrificante da paralizzare il bersaglio, rendendo la tecnica un’aggiunta preziosa all’arsenale del mago.

56.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
56.description: This spell mimics the queer cry of the paissa, which is known to impart those who hear it with the answer to life, the universe, and everything─an experience to which the mind reacts by shutting down entirely, plunging its host into a deep slumber.
56.translation_description: Questa magia imita il verso bizzarro del paissa, capace di rivelare a chi lo sente la risposta alla vita, all’universo e a tutto il resto. La mente reagisce all’esperienza spegnendosi del tutto e precipitando in un sonno profondo.

57.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
57.description: The empuse generates its Eerie Soundwave by rapidly vibrating parts of its body, emitting an unsettling tone that can only be described as “gods-awful.” Said tone can, however, be harnessed by the mage to disrupt certain harmonious aetherial frequencies and nullify their beneficial effects.
57.translation_description: L’empuse genera la sua Onda Sonora Sinistra facendo vibrare rapidamente alcune parti del corpo ed emettendo un tono inquietante, a dir poco orribile. Il mago può però sfruttarlo per disturbare certe frequenze eteree armoniche e annullarne gli effetti benefici.

58.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
58.description: This spell seems fundamentally no different from those used by the conjurers of Stillglade Fane, though upon inquiry as to its detailed workings, an anonymous moogle provided the following words of advice: “Stuff your pom with magic─you know, the sparkly kind─then go 'bwaaa'!”
58.translation_description: Questa magia non sembra molto diversa da quelle usate dagli incantatori del Tempio della Radura Silente. Interrogato sul suo funzionamento, un moguri anonimo ha dato questo consiglio: «Infondi magia nel tuo pom, quella scintillante, e poi fai “bwaaa”!».

59.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
59.description: Only select goblins are privy to this technique, developed through unscrupulous scientific experimentation conducted by the Illuminati. It allows one to weave a thin, skintight veil of aether across their entire body, handily augmenting the usual defenses.
59.translation_description: Solo alcuni goblin conoscono questa tecnica, sviluppata con esperimenti scientifici senza scrupoli dagli Illuminati. Permette di intrecciare un velo etereo aderente alla pelle su tutto il corpo, potenziando facilmente le normali difese.

60.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
60.description: Memorably employed by Byblos, this technique, simply put, drops a massive metal─or, in many cases, aetherial─hammer directly upon a foe's pate with resounding impact. Such foes understandably find their mental acuity somewhat reduced thereafter.
60.translation_description: Usata memorabilmente da Byblos, questa tecnica fa cadere un enorme martello di metallo — spesso etereo — direttamente sulla testa del nemico, con un impatto fragoroso. È comprensibile che in seguito le sue facoltà mentali risultino ridotte.

61.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
61.description: In nature, the queen hawk secretes a particular pheromone when threatened that encourages her adoring swarm to put itself in harm's way in her name. The astute caster may create a similar effect by magical means─acquiring herself a “meat shield,” as it were.
61.translation_description: In natura, la regina dei falchi secerne un feromone quando è minacciata, spingendo il suo sciame adorante a rischiare la vita per lei. Un lanciatore accorto può ricreare magicamente lo stesso effetto e procurarsi, per così dire, uno “scudo di carne”.

62.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
62.description: This incantation-like song is evidently considered a toe-tapper by poroggos─and poroggos exclusively, for to all other creatures it sounds much like a frog being run over by a carriage. Brazenly chanting it without remorse, therefore, is an effective means of drawing ire when necessary.
62.translation_description: Questo canto simile a un’incantazione è chiaramente un motivetto orecchiabile per i poroggo — e solo per loro: alle altre creature sembra il gracidio di un rospo investito da una carrozza. Intonarlo senza vergogna è quindi un modo efficace per attirare l’ira, quando serve.

63.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Wind<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
63.description: A favored technique of the zu, who are able to perform it with a particularly vigorous flap of the wing, Sonic Boom produces a gust of wind-aspected aether so finely compressed that its lethality is oft likened unto that of a finely crafted blade.
63.translation_description: Tecnica prediletta dagli zu, che la eseguono sbattendo le ali con vigore, Esplosione Sonica comprime l’etere di affinità Aero in una raffica tanto concentrata da risultare letale quasi quanto una lama ben forgiata.

64.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
64.description: This technique is in fact one of psychological suggestion, albeit suggestion performed on the self. When the proper pitch is attained, the body will respond by producing adrenaline, which can be used to advantage in combat─or, if one happens to be a dhalmel, in attracting a mate.
64.translation_description: Questa tecnica agisce sulla suggestione psicologica, rivolta però a sé stessi. Raggiunta la nota giusta, il corpo produce adrenalina, utile in battaglia o, per un dhalmel, per attirare un compagno.

65.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
65.description: Developed as an efficient means for subduing heretics, this spell unleashes a concentrated wave of aether that sears and warps the flesh, leaving its target pained and stumbling─particularly if said target has already succumbed to mental torments.
65.translation_description: Sviluppata come metodo efficace per sottomettere gli eretici, questa magia sprigiona un’onda concentrata di etere che brucia e deforma la carne, lasciando il bersaglio dolorante e barcollante, soprattutto se è già tormentato mentalmente.

66.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
66.description: Never particularly concerned with mercy, the Holy See intended this spell to crush heretics' spirits with a mentally destabilizing beam of aether. If the target is already suffering from physical distress, all the better.
66.translation_description: La Santa Sede, poco incline alla clemenza, intendeva fiaccare lo spirito degli eretici con un raggio d’etere destabilizzante. Se il bersaglio è già provato nel fisico, tanto meglio.

67.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
67.description: One of several voidsent curses that rely upon the hubris that living creatures fall prey to upon reaching certain growth malmstones, this spell twists its way into a victim's mind, causing such acute distress that the body's organs are forced to shut down.
67.translation_description: Questa magia è una delle maledizioni delle creature del Vuoto che sfruttano la presunzione degli esseri viventi quando raggiungono determinate tappe della crescita. Si insinua nella mente della vittima e le provoca un dolore tanto intenso da costringere gli organi a smettere di funzionare.

68.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
68.description: This spell─particularly effective on the gullible─conjures a volley of illusory missiles, fooling foes into feeling as if they have met the singularly unpleasant fate of being fired upon by Garlean magitek and causing their bodies to react accordingly.
68.translation_description: Questa magia, particolarmente efficace sui creduloni, evoca una raffica di missili illusori. I nemici credono così di subire il destino sgradevole di essere bersagliati da un magitecno garleano, e il corpo reagisce di conseguenza.

69.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
69.description: Employed to great effect by a certain godlike machine, the concentrated heat that comprises Perpetual Ray has the capacity to deaden nerve endings and sever links between mind and muscle. By directing the beam with particular finesse, the savvy mage can render a foe entirely immobile.
69.translation_description: Usato con grande efficacia da una certa macchina divina, il calore concentrato di Raggio Perpetuo può intorpidire le terminazioni nervose e interrompere i collegamenti tra mente e muscoli. Guidando il raggio con precisione, un mago esperto può immobilizzare del tutto un nemico.

70.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
70.description: Wild sabotenders are believed to have developed this ability to channel their aether toward others as a means of protecting particularly fruitful members of their species─as survival in arid climes ever comes at a cost.
70.translation_description: I sabotender selvatici avrebbero sviluppato questa capacità per condividere l’etere con gli altri e proteggere gli esemplari più fruttuosi della specie: sopravvivere nei climi aridi ha sempre un prezzo.

71.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Blunt<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
71.description: The Whalaqee are generally willing to pass on this close-quarter technique, which allows the mage to harness his own feelings of desperation at being driven closer to death and launch a last-ditch offensive. The name of the creature who originally possessed it, however, remains a closely guarded secret.
71.translation_description: I Whalaqee in genere tramandano volentieri questa tecnica ravvicinata. Permette al mago di convertire la disperazione di chi è prossimo alla morte in un ultimo attacco. Il nome della creatura che la possedeva resta però un segreto ben custodito.

72.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
72.description: The origin of this revitalizing spell is steeped in mystery, as it requires healing aether be amplified through a familiar that appears for all the world to be a messenger from the heavens─a concept soundly at odds with Whalaqee religious beliefs.
72.translation_description: L’origine di questa magia curativa che ridà vigore è avvolta nel mistero: amplifica l’etere di guarigione attraverso un famiglio che sembra un messaggero celeste, concetto in netto contrasto con le credenze religiose dei Whalaqee.

73.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
73.description: This spell enhances the body's natural detoxification processes, stimulating organs and the growth of new tissue. Perhaps due to it having originated with wamourae, it feels much like shedding an old layer of scales.
73.translation_description: Questa magia stimola i naturali processi di disintossicazione del corpo, attivando gli organi e la crescita di nuovi tessuti. Poiché deriva dalle wamourae, ricorda la muta di un vecchio strato di scaglie.

74.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Lightning<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
74.description: This technique strikes a foe with a ball of concentrated electricity─accumulated by wild elder wyverns during their passage through the clouds, but eminently reproducible through magical means─the power of which causes its body to seize as if being crushed by monumental weight.
74.translation_description: Questa tecnica colpisce il nemico con una sfera di elettricità concentrata, accumulata dalle viverne anziane mentre attraversano le nubi, ma facilmente riproducibile con la magia. La scarica irrigidisce il corpo come se fosse schiacciato da un peso immane.

75.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
75.description: No longer merely the domain of savage beasts, this technique, when reproduced by the blue mage, involves not the devouring of rent flesh, but rather heals and invigorates its caster through the absorption of aether.
75.translation_description: Un tempo appannaggio delle sole bestie feroci, questa tecnica assume una forma diversa quando la replica un mago blu: invece di divorare carne lacerata, assorbe etere per curare e rinvigorire chi la lancia.

76.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
76.description: Invented by complete accident whilst a master mechanic attempted to manufacture an automaton that might monitor his lover's suspected illicit activities, and now a staple mechanism of mechanoscribes, Condensed Libra allows for the rapid analysis and amplification of a foe's weaknesses.
76.translation_description: Libra Condensata nacque per caso, quando un maestro meccanico tentò di costruire un automa che sorvegliasse le presunte scappatelle della sua amata. Oggi è un meccanismo essenziale per gli scribameccanici: analizza rapidamente le debolezze dei nemici e le amplifica.

77.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
77.description: A useful little ability originating with the ghrah, Aetheric Mimicry allows the mage to match his aetherial wavelength to that of another person, granting the same benefits as their hard-won combat training.
77.translation_description: La Mimesi Eterea, utile abilità nata tra i ghrah, permette al mago di accordare la propria lunghezza d’onda eterea a quella di un’altra persona e ottenere i benefici dell’addestramento che questa ha conquistato in battaglia.

78.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Earth<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★★<hex:02100103>
78.description: Favored by Ravana, this spell subtly manipulates earth-aspected aether to draw metallic particles from nearby mineral deposits, then propels them forward in an expansive wave to pierce foes' flesh like shrapnel.
78.translation_description: Prediletta da Ravana, questa magia manipola con discrezione l’etere di Pietra per estrarre particelle metalliche dai depositi minerali vicini. Poi le scaglia in un’onda ampia che trafigge la carne nemica come schegge.

79.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★★<hex:02100103>
79.description: Calling upon a rain of aetherial stars like that delivered unto those who upset Sophia's precious harmony, this spell leaves foes shaking from both the impact of a sky fallen and the thought of what fell fate it may portend.
79.translation_description: Richiamando una pioggia di stelle eteree, simile a quella che colpisce chi turba la preziosa armonia di Sophia, questa magia fa tremare i nemici per l’impatto di un cielo crollato e per il terribile destino che potrebbe annunciare.

80.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Blunt<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★★<hex:02100103>
80.description: The signature move of Brute Justice, this technique involves unleashing the full force of justice, delirium unsuspected, static tuned in to reason─before falling back right in with the system, falling back to the end.
80.translation_description: La mossa simbolo di Brute Justice scatena tutta la forza della giustizia: delirio imprevisto e scariche statiche regolate dalla ragione, prima di rientrare nel sistema e tornare al finale.

81.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Piercing<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
81.description: Originally developed by the Namazu as a spearfishing technique, this blindingly fast triple strike has proven just as effective against creatures more intent on devouring the fisher.
81.translation_description: Sviluppato dai Namazu come tecnica di pesca subacquea con la lancia, questo triplo colpo rapidissimo si dimostra altrettanto efficace contro le creature che vorrebbero divorare il pescatore.

82.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Lightning<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
82.description: The Namazu likely named this ability more for the pleasantly tingling current that energizes the caster, rather than the shocking bolt of devastation that smites the distant target. Devised by idle hunters who prefer to stay in one comfortable spot on the river, and strike at whatever swims into range.
82.translation_description: Probabilmente i namazu hanno dato questo nome all’abilità per la corrente piacevolmente frizzante che rinvigorisce chi la lancia, più che per la scarica devastante che colpisce un bersaglio lontano. La inventarono pescatori pigri, decisi a restare comodi sulla riva e colpire ogni pesce a tiro.

83.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
83.description: The dojun-maru employ this ability to weave a row of phantom tatami mats, which they then flip onto an enemy with stunning force. A true master of the technique can even imbue the creation with the faint scent of tatami straw.
83.translation_description: I dojun-maru tessono una fila di tatami illusori e la scagliano contro un nemico con forza stordente. Un vero maestro riesce persino a infondere nella creazione il lieve profumo della paglia intrecciata.

84.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Ice<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
84.description: A mist dragon will instinctively cloak itself in a chilling fog, which allows it to freeze any aggressor foolish enough to test its defenses. Practitioners of this spell have discovered that the trick to not freezing oneself in the process is to surround the body with a pocket of warm air.
84.translation_description: Il drago della nebbia si avvolge d’istinto in una foschia gelida, pronta a congelare chiunque osi metterne alla prova le difese. Chi pratica questa magia ha scoperto il segreto per non congelarsi: circondare il corpo con una sacca d’aria calda.

85.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
85.description: A paean to love favored by Lakshmi, this spell produces an explosion of light, the effect of which varies depending on the caster's mindset─a heart intent on harm will scorch foes caught in the blast, whilst a heart filled with mercy will mend the wounds of those held dear.
85.translation_description: Prediletta da Lakshmi, questa magia è un inno all’amore e crea un’esplosione di luce. L’effetto dipende dall’animo del lanciatore: un cuore colmo di odio brucia i nemici nell’esplosione, mentre uno mosso dalla compassione risana le ferite delle persone care.

86.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
86.description: Cast by, of all things, a phantom train, this purifying light burns away restless spirits and consumes tainted souls. In Garlemald, where travel by machina is commonplace, the tale is told of a spectral locomotive whose passengers are the spirits of the dead...
86.translation_description: Luce purificatrice lanciata, incredibilmente, da un treno fantasma: brucia gli spiriti inquieti e consuma le anime corrotte. In Garlemald, dove viaggiare in machina è normale, si racconta di una locomotiva spettrale con i defunti come passeggeri…

87.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Earth<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
87.description: The signature technique of Tokkapchi, this ability draws on earth-aspected aether to generate a stinging geyser of mud. Widely believed to deal additional psychological damage against opponents dressed in white.
87.translation_description: Tecnica caratteristica di Tokkapchi, attinge all’etere di Pietra per generare un geyser di fango pungente. Si dice che infligga anche danni psicologici agli avversari vestiti di bianco.

88.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
88.description: A spell attributed to the guardian statues of the New World wherein the caster manifests a spread of aetherial treats with panacean properties. Those nourished by the feast find their wounds quickly closing─an effect which lingers when provided by a practitioner with knowledge of healing.
88.translation_description: Attribuita alle statue guardiane del Nuovo Mondo, questa magia crea una varietà di leccornie eteree dalle proprietà panacee. Chi banchetta vede le ferite rimarginarsi in fretta; con un mago esperto di guarigione, l’effetto persiste.

89.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Water<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
89.description: A versatile technique utilized and perfected by Genbu, this magical barrier is formed of water-aspected aether. It works to soften incoming blows, storing energy that can later be unleashed in an explosive torrent.
89.translation_description: Genbu ha perfezionato questa versatile barriera, formata da etere di affinità Idro. Attutisce i colpi in arrivo e ne accumula l’energia, che può poi sprigionare in un torrente esplosivo.

90.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
90.description: This spell imitates the martial technique devised by Ivon Coeurlfist, which in turn mimics the “blaster” attack employed by wild coeurls. Upon casting, a ball of concentrated aether is propelled forward with sufficient force to knock back all but the most implacable opponents.
90.translation_description: Questa magia imita la tecnica marziale ideata da Ivon Coeurlfist, che a sua volta riproduce l’attacco “blaster” dei coeurl selvatici. Al lancio, una sfera d’etere concentrato viene scagliata con forza sufficiente a respingere quasi ogni avversario.

91.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
91.description: A behavior learned from certain species of coeurl, the caster rises to the challenge of losing comrades by tapping into a feral survival instinct. When all seems lost, or when simply treading where a lone mage was not meant to tread, unrestrained ferocity is sometimes the only way to win through.
91.translation_description: Appresa da alcune specie di coeurl, questa tecnica risveglia l’istinto di sopravvivenza di chi ha perso i compagni. Quando tutto sembra perduto, o si affronta un pericolo che un mago solitario non dovrebbe sfidare, solo la ferocia sfrenata può condurre alla vittoria.

92.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
92.description: By manipulating aether to imitate the minute wingbeats of a kongamato, a caster generates an ultrasonic wave which ripples visibly through the surrounding air. The vibrations are lethal to frozen or petrified targets, causing them to shatter with dramatic force.
92.translation_description: Imitando il rapido battito d’ali del kongamato con l’etere, il lanciatore genera un’onda ultrasonica che increspa visibilmente l’aria. Le vibrazioni frantumano con violenza i bersagli congelati o pietrificati.

93.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Ice<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
93.description: Contrary to expectation, the Blaze attack employed by Alte Roite manifests a swirling storm of ice. Some dismiss the spell's name as an odd jest made by the author of the novel in which the winged serpent was first referenced, while others claim the freezing lesions it causes resemble terrible burns.
93.translation_description: Contro ogni aspettativa, l’attacco Fiammata di Alte Roite scatena una tempesta di ghiaccio. C’è chi ritiene che l’autore del romanzo in cui compare per la prima volta il serpente alato abbia scelto il nome per scherzo, e chi invece sostiene che le lesioni da gelo sembrino ustioni tremende.

94.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Fire<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
94.description: A recreation of the terrible chemical explosive employed by Omega, this spell fires a bomb on an arcing trajectory which detonates on impact with the target. The attack is known to leave behind a pungent odor, not unlike mustard.
94.translation_description: Ricreazione del terribile esplosivo chimico usato da Omega, questa magia scaglia una bomba con una traiettoria ad arco che esplode all’impatto. L’attacco lascia un odore pungente, simile a quello della senape.

95.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
95.description: A technique said to originate from the dragons of the New World, this ability cocoons the caster in a sphere of aetherial force which serves to blunt incoming attacks.
