There is some debate on whether the aforementioned “dragons” are truly of dragonkind, or merely a species of “dragon-like” scalekin.
95.translation_description: Si dice che questa tecnica provenga dai draghi del Nuovo Mondo: avvolge il lanciatore in una sfera di forza eterea che attutisce gli attacchi. C’è chi discute se quei “draghi” appartengano davvero alla stirpe draconica o siano solo una specie di rettili simili a draghi.

96.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
96.description: This spell, learned from the dhruva, summons forth a cluster of luminous projectiles which inflict multiple pinpoint wounds to all in their path. The jagged edges of these tiny lacerations bleed profusely, weakening the target and causing considerable pain.
96.translation_description: Appresa dai dhruva, questa magia evoca una nube di proiettili luminosi che infligge a chiunque ne attraversi il cammino molteplici ferite puntiformi. I bordi frastagliati di questi piccoli tagli sanguinano copiosamente, indebolendo il bersaglio e provocando un dolore intenso.

97.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Water<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
97.description: Commonly used amongst Kelpies, this spell generates a powerful current of water which draws in surrounding targets, with even low-flying cloudkin falling victim to its inexorable pull.
97.translation_description: Usata spesso dai kelpie, questa magia genera una potente corrente d’acqua che attira i bersagli vicini. Non sfuggono alla sua forza nemmeno le creature alate che volano a bassa quota.

98.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Water<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
98.description: This example of sai taisui geomancy sends forth a surging wall of water which sweeps along all in its path─friend or foe. One cannot be too careful when toying with maledictions.
98.translation_description: Questa geomanzia dei sai taisui scatena un muro d’acqua che travolge chiunque si trovi sul cammino, alleato o nemico. Meglio fare attenzione quando si gioca con le maledizioni.

99.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
99.description: A destructive ability employed by red chocobos wherein the dust and dirt in the area is drawn up into one solid mass, heated until it glows, then dropped on a target from on high. It is unsurprising, then, that these feathery fiends─also known as courser chocobos─are greeted with near-universal terror.
99.translation_description: Tecnica distruttiva dei chocobo rossi: raccoglie polvere e terra nei dintorni in una massa compatta, la scalda finché brilla e poi la lascia cadere dall’alto sul bersaglio. Non sorprende che questi pennuti feroci, detti anche chocobo da corsa, siano temuti da tutti.

100.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
100.description: A variety of magic employed by New World voidsent, this spell pummels the target with a barrage of incandescent orbs. Its name, likely familiar to scholars of the arcane, is said to have once encompassed the Whalaqee arts of near-death curses and converting life force into mana.
100.translation_description: Magia del Vuoto del Nuovo Mondo che martella il bersaglio con una raffica di sfere incandescenti. Il nome, noto agli studiosi di arti arcane, un tempo indicava anche le arti Whalaqee delle maledizioni che sfiorano la morte e della conversione della forza vitale in mana.

101.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Blunt<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
101.description: Omega's power reigned supreme within the interdimensional rift, allowing it to access a store of collected data and synthesize all manner of entities and objects─including giant, rocket-propelled fists of unyielding metal.
101.translation_description: Nel Varco Interdimensionale Omega dominava ogni cosa: poteva attingere a una raccolta di dati e sintetizzare entità e oggetti di ogni tipo, persino enormi pugni di metallo indistruttibile lanciati da razzi.

102.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Blunt<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★★<hex:02100103>
102.description: This incantation seeks to emulate the supernatural might of the auspice Qitian Dasheng, with the caster leaping into the air, and spinning an elongated staff of pure aether in a whirlwind of brutal force.
102.translation_description: Questa formula tenta di emulare la forza sovrannaturale dell’auspice Qitian Dasheng: il mago salta in aria e fa ruotare un lungo bastone di puro etere in un turbine brutale.

103.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Blunt<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★★<hex:02100103>
103.description: A technique employed by Suzaku, wherein the auspice unleashes a swift series of blurring kicks. The “phantom” half of the name is a somewhat nebulous reference to a constellation in Far Eastern astrology, the sign of which is said to bring good fortune in all matters...except that of matrimony.
103.translation_description: Tecnica di Suzaku: l’auspice scatena una rapida serie di calci così veloci da confondersi. Il riferimento “fantasma” del nome richiama una costellazione dell’astrologia orientale, il cui segno porta fortuna in ogni ambito… tranne che in amore.

104.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★★<hex:02100103>
104.description: This extravagant technique belongs to Tsukuyomi, Lady of the Moon, whose malignant ire manifests as a field of flowers which then burst apart in a hail of deadly petals. Accept the inevitability of the grave, and the power of the nightbloom is yours to wield...
104.translation_description: Questa tecnica spettacolare appartiene a Tsukuyomi, Signora della Luna: la sua ira maligna si manifesta in un campo di fiori che esplodono in una pioggia di petali letali. Accetta l’inevitabilità della tomba e potrai dominare la Fioritura Notturna…

105.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Blunt<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
105.description: Favored by hobgoblins, this time-honored technique operates on the premise of “beating 'em senseless.” Blue mages strengthen the attack by channeling magic into their fists, which come to harbor even greater pummeling potential when coupled with the stones to face one's foe head-on.
105.translation_description: Tecnica tradizionale degli hobgoblin, consiste nel “stordire a suon di botte”. I maghi blu potenziano i pugni incanalandovi la magia; la forza aumenta ancora quando trovano il coraggio di affrontare il nemico faccia a faccia.

106.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Blunt<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
106.description: This spell recreates the devastating way in which the greater armadillo swings an enormous boulder in its clawed tail as if wielding a flail. A boulder is conjured from aether and similarly swung at great speed, sending nearby foes flying.
106.translation_description: Questa magia riproduce la tecnica devastante del grande armadillo, che fa roteare un masso enorme con la coda artigliata come fosse un mazzafrusto. Il mago crea il masso con l’etere e lo scaglia a grande velocità, facendo volare i nemici vicini.

107.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
107.description: Certain species of armadillo have learned to channel aether into their shells, thus granting them the hardness of metal. A similar stratagem allows the blue mage to reflect physical blows back upon an attacker─though unfortunately, both armadillo and man still feel the intial, teeth-rattling impact.
107.translation_description: Alcune specie di armadillo incanalano l’etere nel guscio, rendendolo duro come il metallo. I maghi blu possono imitare questa tecnica e riflettere i colpi fisici contro chi li attacca, ma armadillo e mago subiscono comunque l’impatto iniziale, che fa battere i denti.

108.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★<hex:02100103>
108.description: Particularly savvy armadillos are capable of healing themselves by drawing upon the moisture in the air, and by imitating this behavior, mages can enjoy the selfsame benefits─including flawless skin.
108.translation_description: I sabotender più astuti sanno curarsi assorbendo l’umidità dell’aria. I maghi che ne imitano il comportamento ottengono gli stessi benefici, compresa una pelle perfetta.

109.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
109.description: Acquired from a species of crustacean native to the New World, this spell is executed by blending aether of multiple aspects and unleashing it in one fell blast. This has the effect of disrupting the target's aetheric balance, thereby gradually robbing them of vigor.
109.translation_description: Appresa da una specie di crostaceo originaria del Nuovo Mondo, questa magia unisce etere di vari elementi e lo sprigiona in un unico colpo. Scombina l’equilibrio etereo del bersaglio e ne prosciuga gradualmente il vigore.

110.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Blunt<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
110.description: Embracing rage in the fashion of the spectral berserker allows one to unleash an unbridled wave of destruction. As many a parable will attest, however, anger is a double-edged sword; the spell consumes a great deal of energy, and the caster is advised to be wary of untimely exhaustion.
110.translation_description: Imitando la rabbia del berserker spettrale, il lanciatore scatena un’ondata di distruzione senza freni. Ma la collera è un’arma a doppio taglio: la magia consuma molte energie e può lasciare il mago esausto prima del tempo.

111.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Earth<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
111.description: Taking a filthy page from the mudman, this spell coalesces earth-aspected aether into a clump of mud, which is hurled at enemies. Those who are struck bear stubborn mud stains that diminish their self-worth, causing a lingering enervation.
111.translation_description: Ispirandosi al fango del Mudman, questa magia agglomera etere di Pietra in una zolla e la scaglia contro i nemici. Le macchie ostinate che lascia intaccano l’autostima di chi le subisce e lo debilitano a lungo.

112.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Blunt<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
112.description: Taking a spotless page from the Seeker of Solitude, this spell summons forth a magicked broom to sweep the area clean. Each mud stain it removes serves to affirm its self-worth, and it imparts that sense of well-being to the caster.
112.translation_description: Ispirandosi al Cercatore di Solitudine, questa magia evoca una scopa incantata che spazza l’area. Ogni macchia di fango rimossa ne accresce l’autostima e trasmette al lanciatore una sensazione di benessere.

113.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Slashing<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
113.description: In order to extend its claws for a near-inescapable strike, the Ruby Weapon transforms energy generated by its advanced dynamo unit. Albeit on a smaller scale, the mage recreates this technique by channeling aether into numerous razor-sharp aetherial blades.
113.translation_description: Per estendere gli artigli e sferrare un colpo quasi impossibile da schivare, l’Arma Rubino trasforma l’energia generata dal suo avanzato gruppo dinamo. Il mago imita la tecnica su scala ridotta, canalizzando etere in numerose lame affilate.

114.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
114.description: The language of the fae folk is composed of runes, symbols that harbor magic, and the faerie king Titania was partial to this one. When invoked, it emits an aetheric wave that resonates with the target's magical energies, making them surpassingly easy to extract.
114.translation_description: La lingua del popolo fatato è composta da rune intrise di magia; il re delle fate Titania prediligeva questa. Quando invocata, emette un’onda eterea che risuona con l’energia magica del bersaglio, rendendo quest’ultima facile da estrarre.

115.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★<hex:02100103>
115.description: Employed by Eden Prime, this technique shifts the fabric of reality to trigger a powerful aetheric surge. While it inflicts considerable damage, it demands an extended casting period so as to allow mages to raise a protective barrier over themselves.
115.translation_description: Usata da Eden Prime, questa tecnica altera il tessuto della realtà per innescare un potente flusso di etere. Infligge danni ingenti, ma richiede un lungo tempo di lancio: il mago può sfruttarlo per erigere una barriera protettiva.

116.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
116.description: Learned from the forgiven obscenity, this technique unleashes a beam of Light-aligned aether at opponents. Lest the responsible mage worry, being a scaled-down recreation, the spell does not possess the potency to transform living beings into sin eaters.
116.translation_description: Appresa da Oscenità Redenta, questa tecnica scaglia contro i nemici un raggio di etere di luce. Essendo una replica ridotta, non può trasformare gli esseri viventi in mangiapeccati: il mago può stare tranquillo.

117.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
117.description: Originally employed by Sephirot, the Fiend, to render foes vulnerable to attacks, this spell has been adapted for the mage's own protection. Due to the field's intrinsic instability, however, it cannot simultaneously grant both physical and magical benefits, only one or the other.
117.translation_description: In origine usata da Sephirot, il Demone, per rendere vulnerabili i nemici, questa magia è stata adattata per proteggere il mago. La barriera instabile concede però un solo beneficio alla volta, fisico o magico.

118.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Physical<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Damage: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Piercing<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
118.description: This imitation of the Lightwarden Innocence's technique conjures up swords of Light that rain down from the heavens. Rumor has it Lord Vauthry used the technique to turn sin eaters into meol, which may explain why it appears to bring the caster closer to his perfection.
118.translation_description: Imitazione della tecnica dell’Araldo della Luce Innocence, evoca spade di luce che piovono dal cielo. Si dice che Lord Vauthry usasse questa tecnica per trasformare i mangiapeccati in meol: forse per questo avvicina il mago alla perfezione.

119.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
119.description: Inspired by Eden's Promise, this spell uses the eyes as arcane circles through which aether is channeled─a principle also seen in techniques such as Glower. So concentrated in energy is the beam, it explodes upon contact. Chirurgeon's warning: excessive use may lead to chronic dry eyes.
119.translation_description: Ispirata alla Promessa di Eden, questa magia usa gli occhi come cerchi arcani per incanalare l’etere, proprio come Sguardo Torvo. Il raggio è così concentrato da esplodere all’impatto. Avvertenza del cerusico: l’uso eccessivo può causare secchezza oculare cronica.

120.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★<hex:02100103>
120.description: Loosely based upon Aenc Thon's technique, which saw him wallop foes with a candy cane, this spell sweetens any duel with a rain of confections. The Fuath leader, for one, would not be averse to mages thus spreading the love.
120.translation_description: Ispirata alla tecnica di Aenc Thon, che abbatteva i nemici con un bastoncino di zucchero, questa magia addolcisce ogni duello con una pioggia di dolci. Il sovrano dei fuath, almeno, non si opporrebbe a una simile diffusione d’amore.

121.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Fire<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★<hex:02100103>
121.description: In battle, the familiar Lugus used this technique to create a veritable conflagration. That power is now yours to wield...albeit at a greatly diminished strength. Not wishing to be responsible for burning entire cities down, the Blue Mages' Guild opted to limit the flame's intensity to a gentle sear.
121.translation_description: In battaglia, Lugus usava questa tecnica per creare un vero incendio. Ora puoi farlo anche tu… sebbene con molta meno potenza. Per evitare che i maghi blu bruciassero intere città, la Gilda dei Maghi Blu ha limitato la fiamma a una lieve ustione.

122.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Water<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★★<hex:02100103>
122.description: Part of the nixie's watery repertoire, this technique sends a swirling deluge crashing over enemies─rather too rough for its original purpose of delighting children, but it makes a fine addition to the blue mage's arsenal.
122.translation_description: Parte del repertorio acquatico della nixie, questa tecnica travolge i nemici con un vortice d’acqua. È un po’ troppo violenta per il suo scopo originario, allietare i bambini, ma è preziosa nell’arsenale del mago blu.

123.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★★<hex:02100103>
123.description: While magic is ordinarily woven with words and symbols, this spell employed by the dread creation Therion harnesses the power of emotion to beget destruction. It is said that, if one can cling to the desire for oblivion, it is possible to sustain the ruinous effect indefinitely.
123.translation_description: Di solito la magia si intesse con parole e simboli; questa, usata dalla terribile creatura Therion, canalizza le emozioni per generare distruzione. Si dice che aggrapparsi al desiderio di annientamento permetta di mantenere l’effetto devastante senza limiti.

124.name: <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Type: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>Magic<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Aspect: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>None<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Rank: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>★★★★★<hex:02100103>
124.description: The faerie king Titania's signature move, this spell embodies the disdain, pity, and delight that men's fleeting lives inspire in the fae folk. By weaving layers upon layers of runes to create a deadly maelstrom of magic, you too can remind others of their mortality...until you inevitably meet your own demise.
124.translation_description: Mossa simbolo del re delle fate Titania, incarna il disprezzo, la pietà e la gioia che la breve vita degli umani suscita nel popolo fatato. Intrecciando strati di rune in un vortice magico letale, puoi ricordare a tutti la loro mortalità… finché non incontrerai inevitabilmente la tua.
